title: Rigidity of two constant module models on an overlap
statement: Let X be a scheme, Λ a commutative ring, and F a sheaf of modules over the constant ring sheaf on the small pro-etale site [def-weil-proetale-locally-constant-sheaf]. Let U and V be objects of this site and M and N modules over the lifted coefficient ring. If the restrictions of F to U and V are isomorphic to the respective localized constant models M and N, then any points x of U and y of V with equal image in X give a module isomorphism M ≅ N.

proof.text: Choose a point of U times_X V above the given pair and an algebraic closure of its residue field. Reuse the geometricPoint construction from ProEtaleFiniteModelStalks: pointed weakly etale neighbourhoods form a site point, using their cofilteredness and the section of any nonempty weakly etale scheme over an algebraically closed field. Restrict scalars along the constant ring unit to construct a ModuleCat-valued sheaf from F and from each localized constant model. The module-sheafification unit is locally bijective; the point fibre functor sends it to a bijective linear map, so the fibre of the constant model is its coefficient module. Mathlib filtered-colimit universe shrinking supplies this fact for independent coefficient sizes. Finality of the over-category forgetful functor identifies slice fibres of F with its original fibre. Apply the two slice fibre functors to the trivializations and compose the resulting module isomorphisms.

theorem proEtaleConstantModule_model_rigidity (X : Scheme.{t}) (Λ : Type u) [CommRing Λ]
    (F : SheafOfModules.{max u (t + 1)}
      ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X)
        (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max u (t + 1)} RingCat.{max u (t + 1)})).obj
          ((constantSheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{max u (t + 1)}).obj
            (CommRingCat.of (ULift.{t + 1, u} Λ)))))
    (U V : X.ProEt)
    (M N : ModuleCat.{max u (t + 1)} (ULift.{t + 1, u} Λ))
    (eM : Nonempty (F.over U ≅ proEtaleConstantModuleSheafOverOfUniverses X Λ U M))
    (eN : Nonempty (F.over V ≅ proEtaleConstantModuleSheafOverOfUniverses X Λ V N))
    (x : U.left) (y : V.left) (hxy : U.hom x = V.hom y) : Nonempty (M ≅ N)
